svg.aria-label: Architecture of the agfpga embedded FPGA emulated on AMD Versal
svg.text: agfpga — own embedded FPGA fabric (efpga_v0) emulated on AMD Versal
Phase 0 architecture — FABulous-generated fabric + AXI4-Lite host interface on TE0950 / XCVE2302. Same fabric RTL goes to the ASIC (phase 2).
2.1 ms / bitstream from Linux, ~1.1 s via JTAG
one fabric clock: AXI = config = user CLK
IO_PULSE: inputs driven for EXACTLY N clk
hardened after the byte-wise-write silicon bug
eFPGA_top — fabric efpga_v0 (FABulous-generated RTL, untouched = ASIC source)
16 user IO bels (W_IO, 2 per row) — pins usable as in+out simultaneously (probe trick)
384 LUT4+FF · 8 RegFile 32×4 · 4 MULADD 8×8+20-bit ACC · 16 user IO · bitstream 1806 words
emulation cost: 40 866 Versal LUTs (27.2 % of VE2302) ≈ 106 host LUTs per fabric LC — routing dominates (462 of ~480 cfg bits/tile)
config cells = latches, written by frames — same RTL as the ASIC
6 config bits: A_reg · B_reg · C_reg · ACC · signExtension · ACCout
Vivado 2025.2.1 mis-synthesized the LUT multiplier (ghost carries in
columns 1,2,6,8,10,12 — found with a 1898-product pin probe).
Fix: (* use_dsp *) → real DSP58. Silicon now 1898/1898 exact.
synth_fabulous · --uarch fabulous · frame bitstream → CFG_DATA over AXI (2.1 ms)
ASIC (phase 2): same fabric RTL → LibreLane / OpenROAD → GDSII (IHP SG13G2 / GF180)
Hard blocks PASS on 2 builds · MULADD 1898/1898 products
Fmax per routed design: counter 50–75 · LFSR 75–100 MHz
Host STA can't time configured paths → per-build lottery on
